sloka: तमुवाच सहस्राक्षो लवणो नाम राक्षसः ।मधुपुत्रो मधुवने न ते ऽ ऽज्ञां कुरुते ऽनघ ।। ७.६७.१३ ॥
transliteration: tamuvāca sahasrākṣo lavaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ ।madhuputro madhuvane na te ' 'jñāṁ kurute 'nagha ।। 7.67.13 ॥

translations.english: Indra informed (Shatrughna) that a demon named Lavana, son of Madhu, residing in Madhuvana, does not obey his commands, O sinless one.
